newsitem.title: USA: Metal Management closes Reserve Iron deal.
newsitem.headline: Metal Management closes Reserve Iron deal.

text.p: Metal Management Inc said Tuesday it closed a previously announced acquisition of all the partnership interests in Reserve Iron & Metal L.P. of Cleveland.

Reserve Iron & Metal, a scrap metal recycling company with additional operations in Illinois and Alabama, had gross revenues of $117 million in 1996, Metal Management said. The transaction brings Metal Management's consolidated gross revenues to an annualized rate of about $225 million.
